comment: Klok computes the expander value as `expanderSteps - 1 % k == 0 || expanderSteps % k == 0`, which by C precedence is `(expanderSteps - (1 % k)) == 0 || (expanderSteps % k) == 0`; for any factor above 1 the first clause adds a spurious pulse at count 1. Klok's expanderSteps counter wraps at 256.
